items.title: 3 Top Dividend Stocks to Maximize Your Retirement Income
items.summary: The traditional retirement planning approaches no longer cover all expenses in nest egg years. So what can retirees do? Thankfully, there are alternative investments that provide steady, higher-rate income streams to replace dwindling bond yields.

items.title: Social Security’s 2027 COLA Raise Is the Biggest in 3 Years — But These 5 Dividend Stocks Pay You More
items.summary: Social Security's projected 2027 COLA raise sounds promising until you realize retirees feel higher prices months before benefits catch up. Five blue-chip dividend stocks already pay yields that outpace that adjustment, and some have raised their payouts for decades straight.
